content.comment_body: Hello, I've updated my project by adding and removing several lines and blocks, which has resulted in a cluttered structure. I'm currently finding it difficult to track the inputs and outputs of the blocks. Is there a way to automatically organize my program using [product_name] [version_no]? Thank you.
No, there isn't an option for automatic organization. You will need to arrange everything manually.

Hello, You can use the alignment feature in [product_name], as well as automatic spacing for function blocks both horizontally and vertically. Some users also utilize user-defined functions to simplify their logic. For a clearer view, consider cutting signals and reference lines. Try using the buttons shown in the attached image and consult F1 for additional guidance. Hope this helps:
All these options require manual intervention; there is no fully automated solution.

analysis.insight_summary: Community members expressed difficulty in keeping their projects organized after editing, using [product_name] [version_no]. While users hoped for automated organization, the consensus was that only manual or semi-automated alignment features are available, resulting in limited support for tidying up program layouts.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] [version_no] to offer a simple automated feature for arranging and organizing project elements to make following logic visually straightforward.
